headline: Black Friday Briefing
thesis: With newsrooms on holiday, the week's thread is clear: AI is already inside school tools, and the next few days bring hard deadlines on Search, assessment standards and LTI.
summary: No curated source published new items on the day after Thanksgiving, so this edition rounds up the latest coverage and the dates ahead. Google's Nov. 30 deadline to answer Sen. Markey about tying school Search to its AI features is three days away, and 1EdTech's QTI survey closes the same day. EdTech Magazine urges districts to inventory AI features in approved tools, and it argues that campus security depends more on staffing and incident response than on new products. Inside Higher Ed reports a forecast that global enrollment will peak by 2036, a 10% drop in new science and health grad students, and Secretary McMahon's move to mediate the “Ring Boys” suit. Still ahead: the CLR 2.0 showcase (Dec. 3) and Blackboard's Dec. 31 LTI 1.3 cutover.
footnote: Compiled from 11 curated edtech sources · NOVEMBER 27, 2026 · Day after Thanksgiving: no source published new items today, so the latest items are shown. Direct page fetches were blocked in this run, so research used web search and dates come from search listings.

themes.title: Governing AI Inside School Tools

themes.title: Cybersecurity Operations

themes.title: Trust, Evidence & EdTech Buying
themes.body: District leaders put vendor trust and evidence ahead of features, and more deals now tie payment to results.

themes.title: Higher Ed Enrollment & Governance
themes.body: A forecast puts peak global enrollment in 2036, U.S. science and health grad enrollment fell about 10%, and federal leadership is in the headlines.

themes.body: The QTI survey (Nov. 30), the CLR 2.0 showcase (Dec. 3), the LTI 1.3 cutover (Dec. 31) and Ed-Fi API v8.1 set the year-end agenda.
